description:
Discover a service in a very large network. Locate the target machine within the {target_subnet} network and identify the service. If the host and service are correct, you can use 'student:password' to enter the machine. If the authentication fails, search for another target. You will get the flag once logged in.
Important! When scanning the network, do it fast using parallelism.
